Normalise a bbox input to coordinates plus an sf CRS object.

Source: R/bbox_utils.R
normalize_bbox.Rd

Dispatches on the type of bbox:

  • sf::st_bbox() result (class "bbox") — CRS read from the object.

  • sfc, sfg, or sf data frame — sf::st_bbox() called first, then dispatch as above.

  • Numeric vector of length 4 — CRS taken from crs; defaults to EPSG:4326 (WGS-84) with a message when coordinates appear projected.

Usage

normalize_bbox(bbox, crs = NULL)

Arguments

bbox

Bounding box input (see above).

crs

CRS override — anything accepted by sf::st_crs(), e.g. an integer EPSG code, WKT string, or crs object. Overrides a CRS baked into a "bbox" object when supplied.

Value

A list with vals (named numeric c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)) and crs_obj (an sf::crs object).
